groups.title: Google · Gemini, AI Studio and Antigravity
Anthropic · Claude and its companion tools
Devin Enterprise
groups.gettingStarted: Sign in through your organization and select its training repository. Start a new session. Choose Ask for investigation or planning and Agent when a step asks you to change the practice project.

groups.title: Antigravity
groups.gettingStarted: On your computer, start Antigravity and open an empty practice folder as your project. Use its agent conversation for the prompt, and inspect proposed file changes in the project.

groups.title: Google AI Studio
groups.gettingStarted: Sign in with an eligible Google account. Use a new Playground prompt for model experiments. For labs that build an app, open Build and work in a fresh practice project.

groups.title: Claude Code
groups.gettingStarted: Open a terminal in the practice folder on your computer and start claude. Sign in if prompted, confirm the selected folder, then use the session for prompts. Run verification commands in a separate terminal in that same folder.

groups.title: Codex
groups.gettingStarted: Open the practice project in the Codex app or start the signed-in Codex CLI in its folder. Paste the brief into the task composer. Labs that specify codex exec use the CLI in a terminal.

groups.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot
groups.gettingStarted: Sign in with your work or school account and start a fresh Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat. Paste just the synthetic inputs the step specifies. For exercises in Word, Excel or PowerPoint, use the supported work app or the chat alternative given in the lab.

groups.title: Gemini App & Gemini Notebook
groups.gettingStarted: Open Gemini in a browser or its app. Choose a new chat. For a Notebook lab, open Gemini Notebook and add the practice notes as sources. Each lab tells you which screen to use.

groups.title: Troubleshoot M365 with AI
groups.gettingStarted: Open the case files inside each lab, or unzip the practice kit. Work from the rows on paper offline. Use an approved AI chat only with the stripped-down practice packet.

groups.title: Data safety at work
groups.startLabel: Open the account and access guide
groups.gettingStarted: Use the fictional practice packet. Start with the policy card and decide whether the stripped-down excerpt is allowed in the selected tool. All six cases also work on paper.

groups.title: Ship a personal app
groups.gettingStarted: Use an empty practice folder and the game file in the first lab. Try the checks on your device. Publish only the public-safe game when you choose to host your own copy.
